title: Keeping the beings out of the official report to protect his Personnel Reliability Program status

tellings.quote: had I said that I saw these beings they would have immediately removed me from the PE RP personal reliability program

plain: Mario Woods, who guarded nuclear weapons at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, says he saw beings in 1977 but left them out of his official report. He tells Michels that if he had reported them he would have been removed at once from the Personnel Reliability Program, the screening that certifies people as fit to work with nuclear weapons. If true, it suggests that sightings at nuclear sites may go unreported because of the risk to the witnesses' careers.
